accuracyFlags: Section 04 lists the Desert Road among roads where chain fitting is 'required at times': the Desert Road (SH1) is usually closed rather than chain-controlled; verify against NZTA before keeping.

FAQ says 'Rental campervans usually carry them' (chains) while body says 'some rental agreements require you to carry them': inconsistent and unsourced; many rentals prohibit or exclude winter alpine use.
Refers to 'NZTA' and 'Waka Kotahi' interchangeably in sections 01 and 07; use NZTA Waka Kotahi once with the official link.
Midwinter 'roughly nine hours of usable light in the south' is unsourced; MetService/NIWA sunrise tables give about 8.5 h in Queenstown at the solstice.
